full_prompt_en: A square landscape photograph shows a still alpine pond reflecting a fiery sunset beneath a range of dark mountains. The pond occupies the middle and lower-left, its glassy surface mirroring orange-pink clouds and several narrow conifer silhouettes. A dense clump of red, rust and yellow leaves fills the near lower-right foreground, standing sharply against dark grasses and water. Across the far bank, tawny reeds and low red shrubs make a narrow horizontal strip before the mountain slopes. Tall pines rise in small irregular groups along the left and center horizon, their black forms interrupting the brightest part of the sky. The mountains behind them step toward the right, shifting from distant blue-gray peaks to a steep dark ridge at the edge. Above, heavy indigo and violet clouds sweep diagonally across the upper half, opening near the left-center horizon to a vivid band of gold, coral and magenta light. The same warm colors spread into the pond as softly broken reflections, while deeper blue shadows remain at the water's margins. Long exposure-like clarity preserves small leaves and distant outlines without visible human activity. Light comes from the low setting sun behind the trees, rim-lighting the far grasses and making the foreground foliage glow from within; the mountain sides and near ground stay dark. No buildings, people or readable text appear. The overall composition is serene but dramatic, balancing a quiet reflective center with saturated warm color at the horizon and dense cool cloud above.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形风景照片呈现一池静止的高山水面，在深色群山下映出火红日落。池塘占据中部与左下，玻璃般的水面倒映橙粉云彩和几道细长针叶树剪影。一簇密集红、锈与黄叶填满近处右下前景，在深草和水面前显得清晰。远岸上，棕黄色芦草与低矮红灌木在山坡前形成狭窄横带。高松在左侧与中央地平线不规则成组升起，黑色形体打断天空最亮之处。它们后方的群山向右层叠，从远处蓝灰峰峦过渡到边缘陡峭深色山脊。上方，厚重靛蓝与紫云斜扫上半部，在左中地平线附近打开一道金、珊瑚与洋红的鲜艳亮带。相同暖色在池水中成为柔和破碎的倒影，水边仍留深蓝暗影。近似长曝光的清晰度保留细小叶片和远景轮廓，没有可见人类活动。光来自树后低处落日，给远岸草丛镶边，也让前景叶子像从内部发亮；山坡和近处地面保持深暗。没有建筑、人物或可读文字。整体构图平和却戏剧性强，以安静倒影中心平衡地平线的饱和暖色和上方浓密冷云。
style_prompt_en: A high-dynamic-range landscape-photography treatment balances richly saturated warm light with deep cool shadows. Indigo and violet cover broad upper and side areas; coral, amber and crimson concentrate in a narrow luminous zone and repeat as softened reflections below. Fine detail stays readable in both near texture and distant silhouettes, while cloud forms remain sweeping and atmospheric. Low backlight creates glowing edges and lets darker masses hold their shape without flattening to black. A calm horizontal reflective field stabilizes energetic diagonal cloud movement. The composition places saturated accents near the central horizon and a sharp textured cluster close to the viewer, producing depth, stillness and a cinematic sense of changing light.
style_prompt_zh: 高动态范围风景摄影处理让浓烈饱和暖光与深冷阴影保持平衡。靛蓝与紫色覆盖宽阔上方和两侧；珊瑚、琥珀与绯红集中在狭窄发光区域，并在下方以柔化倒影重复。近处肌理与远方剪影都有可读细节，云形则保持扫动的空气感。低逆光制造发亮边缘，也让深色体量保有形状，不被压平为纯黑。平静水平反射色域稳定了活跃的斜向云层运动。构图在中央地平线附近放置饱和色重音，在近处安排一团锐利有纹理的色块，形成纵深、静止感和电影般变化的光。
theme_en: Fiery sunset reflected in an alpine pond among autumn shrubs and dark pines
theme_zh: 高山池塘映出火红日落，周围是秋色灌木和深色松树
name: Sean Bagshaw
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
